name: Scott Tanzillo
headline: Sales Executive
about:
As an award-winning sales executive, top-performing contributor, and strategic business leader, I bring an exemplary track record in selling complex software solutions, consistently exceeding sales quotas, and delivering some of the largest deals ever for the companies I represent. I excel at building mission-critical relationships and partnerships, skillfully delivering innovative business solutions based on cutting-edge technologies, and helping senior leadership teams achieve exceptional revenue growth in short timeframes. Merging standout communication skills with an unwavering drive to take on the biggest challenges—I work effectively across business functions and at every level of the enterprise to help teams achieve new levels of performance, close major deals, and deliver results that repeatedly surpass expectations.
… more

experiences.description:
A SaaS provider of ERP and eCommerce solutions for Retail, Wholesale, and General Business clients, NetScore provides award-winning solutions seamlessly built on the world's leading Cloud ERP and eCommerce platforms. 
•	Lead new sales and account management for SaaS applications, pre-built and custom cloud integrations, and professional services for the Oracle NetSuite Ecosystem. Target mid-market and enterprise companies in the Wholesale Distribution, Retail, General Business, eCommerce, Manufacturing, and Healthcare verticals.
•	Delivered standout sales performance, closed major deals, and set new company records, representing 3,900% growth in subscriptions and related professional services revenue and a 1,800% increase in new customers.  Surpassed quota every year in role: FY 2019, FY 2020, FY 2021, FY 2022, FY 2023, FY 2024. 
•	Key achievements include closing the largest deal in the 12-year history of the company within the first 6 months, delivering NetScore’s largest-ever Point of Sale contract, successfully growing Point of Sale revenue by 400% in year one, and increasing the average selling price by 187%.
•	Maintain a core focus on customer success in the delivery of service offerings, encompassing Integration Services, ERP and NetSuite SuiteCommerce Implementations, Scripting, Customizations, and Data Migrations. 
•	Led a major transformation, shifting from 90% Oracle NetSuite Implementation Services as an Alliance Partner and 10% annual subscription revenue as an SDN Partner, to generating 90% of all revenue from subscriptions and related professional services. 
•	Introduced and led the adoption of NetScore POS, Field Service, Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS), and Loyalty Rewards applications. Sell Built for Oracle NetSuite (Suite Cloud Development Network) applications, including Rental Management, Delivery Routing, POS, Loyalty Rewards, Field Service, WMS, Service & Maintenance, and Integration Software Solutions.

A leading provider of cloud integration solutions, Celigo is trusted by 1,900+ customers and was recognized as a visionary in Gartner's Magic Quadrant for Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) for two consecutive years. Celigo also provides pre-built integrations between cloud applications, including NetSuite, Salesforce, Amazon, Magento, SAP, Shopify, Zendesk, and Oracle, backed by support and recommendations from real human experts.
•	Sold a portfolio of cloud integration solutions, including integrator.io, a next-generation integration Platform (iPaaS) that connects cloud-based applications to automate business processes. Delivered integration solutions for Oracle NetSuite, Salesforce, Microsoft, SAP, Acumatica, ADP, Amazon, Avalara, and Magento. 
•	Closed strategic deal in week two with Celigo, achieved recognition as the #2 Account Executive in the company in August 2018, and ranked as the #3 Account Executive in the company in September 2018.
•	Covered the EMEA, Latin America, NJ, PA, MI, TN, IN, IA, and KS in the eCommerce, Retail, Wholesale Distribution, Manufacturing, General Business, and Nonprofit verticals. Closed strategic deals internationally with Ancient Nutrition, The ICEE Company, Nuheara, Redranger, and Outdoor Concepts.

Providing premium golf club rentals to make golf travel a truly enjoyable experience, ClubHub delivers premium rental clubs to any Hotel, Golf Course, or Staffed Business Location in the continental USA. 
•	Served as a strategic advisor to ClubHub’s owner on technology systems and priority initiatives, designed and implemented a new operational infrastructure, and delivered a 248% increase in sales revenue over two years. Developed and led corporate presentations to successfully raise capital from individual investors. 
•	Led platform deployments and operational enhancements, including Oracle NetSuite ERP and eCommerce, an inventory management system, fulfillment processes, and the launch of an integrated distribution center.
•	Managed key strategic partnerships with NBC GolfNow (Golf Channel) and TaylorMade Golf.

•	Responsible for business development and account management for fully integrated enterprise SaaS ERP and omni-channel solutions.
•	Top 10 Sales Executives for NetSuite Global Sales Organization, 2013 & 2011. 
•	Achieved more than 200% of quota twice: 2013 (231%) and 2011 (211%).
•	Produced 3 years of consecutive quarterly and monthly quota attainment.
•	Closed NetSuite's second-highest transaction volume customer in 2013, with ThinkGeek (GameStop, #302 on Fortune 500). Closed a three-year deal with Natural Markets Food Group in 2013, with a total value of $1.2M. Closed a three-year, $1.5M deal with DrJays.com, the largest and most strategic NetSuite deal in 2011. 
•	Presented with numerous awards, including Club Evil (Award Ceremony at the Grand Prix in Montreal, Canada; awarded engraved ring #40 in NetSuite Company History), President's Club, Worldwide Rookie of the Year, #1 Central Region while first year at NetSuite, #1 eCommerce.
•	Pioneer in NetSuite's eCommerce Vertical, closing first-ever NetSuite SuiteCommerce Advanced enterprise eCommerce deal. 
•	Established and fostered relationships and conducted joint sales campaigns with NetSuite Executive Management and Partners that included NetSuite CEO, NetSuite President & COO, Deloitte, Capgemini, Accenture, and Wipro. 
•	Promoted to Senior Sales Role after one year of joining NetSuite.
•	Maintained and applied expert domain and network expertise in ERP, Finance, Integration, and Supply Chain. Covered platform dynamics, business value analytics, competitive offerings, system integration with enterprise systems, and emerging technologies. 
•	Assisted NetSuite Sales Executives in Closing and Negotiating deals. 
•	Established cross-functional teams from business units that included legal, professional services, vertical market experts, executive leadership, solution consultants, and technical services.

Profitics provides an enterprise software platform to Fortune 50 companies for projected product demand vs. actual, systematic management of trade funds and marketing budget allocations, “what if” scenario analysis, cross-sell & up-sell algorithms, quantitative lift elasticity, channel demand by category, geography, and seasonality.  The solution integrates with sales channels, commerce platforms, and marketing data management (MDM) repository. 
•	Established top-level executive relationships throughout the retail and consumer package goods (CPG) space, with companies that included Kraft, Walgreens, Office Depot, Office Max, H.J. Heinz, Kellogg’s, Family Dollar, and McCormick & Co.
•	Responsible for identifying and establishing the company’s target market and implementing strategic and solution-selling methodologies to increase solution value and convey an in-depth understanding of client business operations and requirements.  
•	Developed and deployed new sales processes for pricing and marketing analytics/optimization. 
•	Repositioned marketing collateral, web presence, and corporate messaging to shift the Profitics offering from consulting services only to a combined offering for a software platform with value-added services.
•	Recruited, hired, and managed up to 10 vendors and a range of personnel tasked with marketing and sales operations, business development, search engine optimization (SEO) initiatives, and the company presence and exhibit at the 2010 National Retail Federation (NRF) Annual Convention. 
•	Led a sales force automation initiative, generated buy-in from company leadership, negotiated a deal in collaboration with management and Salesforce.com, and delegated responsibilities for implementation.

experiences.position: Director of Sales and Business Development
experiences.description:
•	Responsible for sales and business development for enterprise IT infrastructure management software, serving clients around the world, with a major presence in Europe and Asia.
•	Achieved standout sales and revenue growth including a 158% increase in YoY revenue in 2007, a $1M+ increase in software and maintenance renewals in 2008, and set new sales records for five consecutive months from March to August of 2007.
•	Closed the largest contract in company history in the first seven months as Director; executed 42 reseller agreements in 12 counties; and won a series of major, complex deals with organizations that included IBM, Midas, NASA, Verizon, Walt Disney Company, the U.S. Navy, and Boeing.
•	Spearheaded an initiative to renegotiate pricing and critical contract terms with the General Services Administration (GSA) and a variety of Federal Government clients.
•	Developed and implemented an improved pricing model, instituted new changes in product positioning, and created more effective marketing strategies for offerings across the company.
•	Improved processes for accounts receivable, billing, and client management; implemented Salesforce.com to vastly improve lead conversion, control workflow automation, and streamline software renewals; these initiatives doubled sales in less than one year without adding additional personnel. 
•	Created highly engaging marketing and promotional campaigns to build the customer base and drive revenue; planned digital and traditional ad campaigns, crafted messaging, and developed content.

•	Responsible for sales of business intelligence (BI) and business analytics software to healthcare systems and hospitals.
•	Closed a range of high value, long-term sales contracts and secured new accounts with Iowa Health System, Pascack Valley Hospital, and Evangelical Community Hospital. 
•	Led a rapid client base growth, taking Organizational Intelligence from just one account in four years, to four new clients in the first five months after joining the company.
•	Increased revenues from zero to $465K in five months through direct sales efforts, conducting market research, reworking pricing models, executing a name change and rebranding initiative, improving web channels, developing marketing campaigns, and refining corporate messaging to a value-based focus.
•	Traveled 25% of the time, across the United States, to deliver presentations to prospects, attend trade shows and industry conferences, and network with key executives and technical experts.

• Brainbench (Acquired by PreVisor 2006).
• Brainbench provides an enterprise software platform that helps companies such Advance Auto Parts, British Telecommunication, Citigroup, IBM, Manpower, U.S. Army and Wells Fargo. The platform improves hiring, retention, training, customer satisfaction, and profitability by testing, tracking, and improving employees' vital job characteristics using the industry's largest library of tests. Brainbench has delivered over 30 million tests to over 11 million registered users.
• #2 salesperson of 13. 
• Achieved 128% of sales quota.
• Closed 2nd and 4th largest deals for 2003.
